column1: # Every stack operation MUST go through scripts/stack.sh, which reads this
# file to resolve the compose project name, working directory, env file,
# expected host ports, expected image refs and the risk class. Direct
# identity checks) and allowlist enforcement — do not use them for stack
# Columns (tab-separated, one stack per line, '#' starts a comment):
#   id            short stack identifier used as `stack.sh <id> <cmd>`
#   dir           compose working directory, relative to repository root
#   project       canonical compose project name (-p). Must be unique per
#                 stack; the directory default is NOT acceptable because it
#                 collides across stacks that share a compose file.
#   env_file      --env-file path relative to repository root, or '-' for none.
#                 The file is gitignored (.tmp/) and holds secrets; the
#   ports         comma-separated expected published host ports (loopback).
#                 Preflight refuses `up` if any is bound by another project.
#   images        comma-separated expected image refs from `compose config`.
#                 `repo` matches any tag of that repo; `repo:tag` must match
#                 exactly. Update this column deliberately when re-pinning.
#   compose_files comma-separated compose file names relative to dir
#   notes         free text (may contain spaces; must be last column)
